evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Colaborar com as áreas de negócio na definição de requisitos
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role centers on building and maintaining the internal data infrastructure (databases, warehouses, ETL) rather than serving a specific commercial, product, or finance function.
evidence.autonomy_level: Colaborar com as áreas de negócio na definição de requisitos

evidence.ai_role_explanation: Artificial intelligence is mentioned only as a general project area the role may participate in ('projetos de... inteligência artificial'), with no specific AI skill or tool expected of the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: Garantir a qualidade, fiabilidade e desempenho dos dados

evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Garantir a qualidade, fiabilidade e desempenho dos dados
